name: How do you handle moisture and waterproofing before finishing a basement?

mainEntity.name: How do you handle moisture and waterproofing before finishing a basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moisture management must come before any framing or drywall work. Start by inspecting foundation walls and concrete floor slabs for active leaks, efflorescence, or cracks. If you notice water intrusion, you must resolve exterior grading, extend downspouts, or install an interior drainage system and sump pump first. For basement environments, contractors apply vapor barriers against concrete walls and select moisture-resistant materials, such as mold-inhibiting drywall and rigid foam insulation, to protect the living space against condensation from underground temperature swings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Address water issues first by checking grading and fixing cracks. Install vapor barriers and rigid insulation before framing to prevent condensation and moisture damage behind walls.
